info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Program Trading Insights API
info.description: The Program Trading Insights API provides comprehensive data retrieval capabilities for wholesale trading programs. It enables users to access critical information related to program trading metrics and performance. This API is primarily designed for financial analysts and traders seeking to make informed decisions based on real-time trading data. Use cases typically include performance analysis, strategy evaluation, and market trend assessment, enhancing the overall trading effectiveness.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about the program trading resource identified by RES-100045. It is intended for clients looking to gain insights into the specific trading program, including its parameters and status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to a specific program trading operation. The payload should contain the necessary parameters to successfully fetch the desired data related to the operation identified by RES-100045.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the resource is returned.

GetProgramTradingResource100045Request.description: A JSON string representation used in the request body for the wholesale trading program trading operations.
